sources.name: ZonaTMO
sources.notes: The original TuMangaOnline/ZonaTMO operation (zonatmo.com) was shut down by Spanish police in March/April 2026 and its domain is in registrar clientHold; zonatmo.org is one of several unaffiliated mirror domains that appeared afterward, so its markup and uptime are not guaranteed to track the original site and should be re-checked before every version bump. v2 scopes the chapters container away from generic page chrome and adds dedupeByNumber, since TMO-style pages list the same chapter once per scanlation group under distinct viewer URLs, which previously produced duplicate chapter rows. v3 (2026-07-27) fixes popular/discover.popular pointing at '/', which currently serves a 'restableciendo contenido' (content being restored) placeholder instead of the manga grid post-shutdown; both routes now point at '/biblioteca' (sorted by likes_count), the same route discover.types.operation already used successfully. Keep testing until Search → Detail → Chapters → Pages → First image passes live validation.
